meals.strInstructions:
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and whisk until smooth.
Melt the butter in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat until foaming.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula for 30 seconds, then leave to set for a minute.
Scatter the cheese over one half, fold the omelette over and slide onto a plate.

meals.strMeal: Egg Fried Rice with Spring Onions
meals.strInstructions:
STEP 1
Cook the rice according to the packet instructions, drain and spread out on a tray to cool.

STEP 2
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok until smoking. Add the beaten eggs and scramble for 30 seconds.

STEP 3
Add the cold rice and peas and stir-fry for 3 minutes.

STEP 4
Splash in the soy sauce, add the sliced spring onions and toss everything together. Serve hot.

1. Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted boiling water until al dente.
2. Meanwhile heat the olive oil in a pan and gently fry the garlic for one minute.
3. Tip in the chopped tomatoes, add a pinch of sugar and simmer for 12 minutes.
4. Drain the pasta, toss through the sauce and top with torn basil and grated parmesan.

Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the chopped onions for 8 minutes until golden.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken pieces and brown on all sides.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes and coconut milk, season and simmer for 25 minutes.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and serve with rice.

Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Melt half the butter with the olive oil in a heavy pan over a medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through. Add the remaining butter and the garlic and spoon the garlic butter over the chicken for a minute. Rest for 5 minutes, sprinkle with parsley and serve.

Sift the plain flour, baking powder and sugar into a large bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg and melted butter together, then pour into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a lightly oiled frying pan over a medium heat and pour in a ladleful of batter.
Cook until bubbles appear, flip and cook for another minute. Serve with maple syrup.

STEP 1
Fry the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and minced beef and brown well.

STEP 2
Stir in the chilli powder, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.

STEP 3
Add the chopped tomatoes, kidney beans and a splash of water. Simmer for 40 minutes.

STEP 4
Season to taste and serve with rice and soured cream.

Heat the sesame oil in a wok and stir-fry the carrots and red pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice and sweetcorn and keep stir-frying until piping hot.
Add the soy sauce and sliced spring onions, toss and serve.

Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan and soften the onion and red pepper for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for a minute.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.

1. Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, reserving a mug of the cooking water.
2. Fry the streaky bacon in a dry pan until crisp.
3. Beat the egg yolks with the grated parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
4. Drain the pasta, toss with the bacon off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture, loosening with a splash of cooking water.

Heat the oven to 200C. Cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Mix the drained pasta with the tuna, sweetcorn, cream cheese and a splash of milk.
Tip into a baking dish, top with grated cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

STEP 1
Melt the butter in a large pan and soften the onion and leek for 8 minutes.

STEP 2
Add the diced potatoes and stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes.

STEP 3
Blend until smooth, stir in the milk and season. Reheat gently and serve with bread.

Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a pan and sear the salmon fillets skin-side down for 4 minutes.
Flip, pour over the sauce and cook for 3 more minutes, basting as it thickens.

Heat the oven grill. Soften the chopped onion in olive oil in an ovenproof pan, then wilt in the baby spinach. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables. Crumble over the feta and cook gently for 5 minutes until almost set. Finish under the grill for 3 minutes until golden, then cut into wedges.

Fry the onion, carrots and celery in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and garlic, then add the red lentils and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft. Blend half the soup for a creamy texture.
Finish with lemon juice and season well.

STEP 1
Toss the sliced beef with cornflour and half the soy sauce.

STEP 2
Stir-fry the beef in a very hot wok for 2 minutes, then remove.

STEP 3
Stir-fry the broccoli and garlic for 3 minutes, return the beef and add the oyster sauce and remaining soy sauce.

STEP 4
Serve over steamed rice.

Fry the sliced mushrooms in butter until golden and any liquid has evaporated. Set aside.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and cook in a buttered pan, stirring until just set.
Spoon the mushrooms over, fold and serve.

meals.strMeal: Baked Potatoes with Beans and Cheese
meals.strInstructions:
Heat the oven to 220C. Prick the potatoes and bake for 1 hour until crisp outside and soft inside.
Warm the baked beans in a small pan.
Split the potatoes, add a knob of butter, spoon over the beans and top with grated cheddar.

1. Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
2. Mix the paprika, cumin, chilli powder and oil and toss through the chicken.
3. Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 6 minutes, add the vegetables and cook for 4 more minutes.
4. Squeeze over lime juice and serve in warm tortillas with soured cream.

Heat the oven to 200C.
Toss the potatoes, carrots, red onion and courgette with the olive oil, thyme, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until caramelised.

Mash the bananas in a bowl and mix in the eggs and oats.
Fry spoonfuls in a lightly oiled non-stick pan for 2 minutes each side.
Serve with sliced strawberries and a drizzle of honey.

Butter the outside of the bread slices. Layer sliced cheddar and tomato between two slices with a pinch of salt. Toast in a hot frying pan for 3 minutes each side, pressing down, until the bread is golden and the cheese has melted.

STEP 1
Fry the garlic and chilli in the oil for 30 seconds.

STEP 2
Add the prawns and cook until pink, then push to the side and scramble in the egg.

STEP 3
Tip in the cold rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes with the fish sauce and soy sauce.

STEP 4
Finish with lime juice and chopped spring onions.

Cook the macaroni in boiling salted water until tender, then drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the plain flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in most of the cheddar and the mustard, then fold through the macaroni.
Tip into a dish, scatter with the remaining cheese and grill until bubbling.

Fry the onion in the oil until soft, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add the chickpeas and chopped tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir through the baby spinach until wilted and serve with rice.

1. Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper.
2. Melt the butter in a frying pan and cook the cod for 4 minutes each side.
3. Add the lemon juice and parsley to the pan, spoon over the fish and serve with new potatoes.

Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until tender, drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Meanwhile grill or fry the sausages for 15 minutes, turning, until browned.
Fry the sliced onion until soft, add a splash of water and serve everything together.

Put the porridge oats, milk and a pinch of salt in a pan and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring. Grate in the apple, add the cinnamon and cook for another minute. Spoon into bowls and drizzle with honey.

Chop the tomatoes, cucumber and red onion into chunks and put in a bowl with the olives.
Top with the feta, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, and sprinkle with oregano.

STEP 1
Mix the minced beef with the chopped onion, salt and pepper and shape into four patties.

STEP 2
Fry or grill the patties for 5 minutes each side.

STEP 3
Top with cheese for the last minute, then serve in burger buns with lettuce and tomato.
